up: List all drugs that are approved for breast cancer, meaning they have an approved indication (max_phase_for_ind = 4) in the drug_indication table where the indication corresponds to breast cancer (mesh_heading = 'Breast Neoplasms' OR efo_term = 'breast cancer'). For each such drug, provide the following columns: the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name) from molecule_dictionary, the canonical SMILES structure (canonical_smiles) from compound_structures (if available, left join to include drugs without a structure), and indication details from drug_indication: the MeSH heading (mesh_heading), EFO term (efo_term), and the maximum phase for that indication (max_phase_for_ind). Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molregno, and left join compound_structures on molregno. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE (di.mesh_heading = 'Breast Neoplasms' OR di.efo_term = 'breast cancer') AND di.max_phase_for_ind = 4;
